|game_text=If your [Dagobah] objective on table, deploy on table and stack five Jedi Tests from outside the game face up here. I Won't Fail You: Only Luke may be your apprentice. You may deploy face up Jedi Tests from here as if from hand. Place completed Jedi Tests on table. Jedi Tests are suspended (not lost) while Luke not on table. I've Got To Go To Them: Once per turn, if you just lost Force from a Force drain and you do not occupy a battleground, turn a Jedi Test here face down. Remember Your Failure At The Cave: During battle, Jedi Test #3 is suspended unless Luke battling alone.

|rulings=* Light may stack any five Jedi Tests, even duplicates. (One each of Jedi Tests 1 - 5 are recommended).<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Patience%21 Scomp: Patience!]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* Whenever [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] leaves table (or is inactive), all Jedi Tests on table are suspended, whether the tests are complete or incomplete. If [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] returns to the table (or returns to being active) the tests are no longer suspended.
* If during the course of battle, [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] switches from being alone to not (or vice versa), Jedi Test #3 will likewise switch to being suspended (or vice versa).
* Although completed Jedi Tests are placed on table, they are 'treated as if stacked on the apprentice' meaning that (among other things) the apprentice may NOT repeat previously completed Jedi Tests.
